property_summary: For any target and amount, the reference C never reverts when sendMoney is called even if the callee's fallback reverts (it ignores the low-level call's failure), whereas the mutant using transfer will revert when the callee rejects receiving ETH; thus the property is that sendMoney never reverts (ok==true) for all inputs on the reference.
change_summary: Change low-level call to use a transfer, which will revert on failure instead of returning false, altering whether sendMoney reverts for certain target behaviors.
